name: sir-review
description: GitHub Action: plain-English review of SIR contract changes in pull requests

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --preserve-symlinks --outfile=dist/index.cjs --banner:js="// rederive/sir-review: built from src/index.mjs and the rederive npm package (npm run build). Do not edit." --log-level=warning
scripts.check-dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist/
